messages:
maria: Quick Q — I opened a small Terraform + k8s change for inference-gateway. Plan is: reduce replicas 6 -> 3 for steady-state, set Deployment.strategy.rollingUpdate to maxSurge: 0 / maxUnavailable: 1, and add rollout annotation for a 5% canary. Also need to switch secretRef to use the new KMS key path (teams/security rotated keys). Can someone eyeball before I merge? PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4827

raj: what’s the reasoning on dropping to 3 replicas? any perf risk at peak?

maria: traffic has been flat for last 2 weeks and we were overprovisioned during low usage window. Autoscaler will still bump if CPU > 60%. This is just to reduce steady-state GPU-hours. Can revert quickly if latency spikes.

elaine: make sure HPA.minReplicas stays at 2 so we don’t cold-start too many pods. Also can we keep a pod anti-affinity so those 3 aren’t all on same node?

ops-bot: FYI — security rotation: new KMS path is projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/inference-v2. Update secret manager reference accordingly.

maria: yep updated the TF var and added secret manager lookup. snippet I used: 
```hcl
resource "google_secret_manager_secret_version" "inference_kms" {
  secret      = var.inference_kms_secret
  secret_data = data.google_kms_secret_ciphertext.inference_kms.plaintext
}
```

raj: can you paste the k8s rollout fragment? want to check maxUnavailable semantics with HPA.

maria: pasted below — it’s a plain Deployment change, not StatefulSet:
```yaml
strategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxSurge: 0
    maxUnavailable: 1
metadata:
  annotations:
    rollout.redwood.ai/canary: "5%"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchExpressions:
                  - key: app
                    operator: In
                    values:
                      - inference-gateway
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        env:
        - name: KMS_SECRET_PATH
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: inference-kms-secret
              key: key_path
```

ci-bot: buildkite status: pipeline/inference-main #4827 — tests passed (unit + lint). Integration tests queued.

deploy-bot: note: changing maxSurge to 0 disables parallel create+delete; rollout will be sequential. Expect slightly longer rollout on minor updates.

elaine: if rollout time is longer, we should temporarily bump readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds to avoid killing pods during image pull spikes. Maybe +5s?

maria: good call — added readiness increase in PR to 10s.

raj: okay — assuming HPA minReplicas=2 and anti-affinity in place I’m +1. Will watch metrics during canary. Who runs the canary?

simon: I can run the canary tonight at 05:15 UTC. I’ll route 5% traffic via the router and keep an eye on p99 latency and error rate.

maria: awesome — thank you. Simon, I’ll add you to PR and put a short checklist in the PR description (monitor p99, errors, replicate removal fallback).

ops-bot: reminder: need terraform plan/apply in infra repo after PR merges. Typical flow: `tf plan -var-file=team.tfvars` then ops review.

maria: noted — I won’t merge until simon confirms canary window is scheduled and ops runs plan. Leaving the PR in review. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
